# P002 S4 actual plan-to-dev trial

Actual author: session-plan, sole fixture plan writer. Continuation
P002-20261029-A-CONT-20261105; historical run P002-20261029-A.
Starting plan HEAD8306309107abc55453241efc6de5e4d81c47947e;
observed committed dev HEADd459aea8f44e1727f5c46d98e99220e3a3de5076.
Plan directly read the current queue: plan next P904, dev next P901, no pauses or
pending decisions. Historical results and continuation C3 boundaries are preserved.

This is the harmless committed artifact for S4's first actual direction,
WORK_READY targeting dev. Its exact full document commit is recorded in the
subsequent event and actual host delivery. PENDING is not delivery or receipt.

Recipient action: directly read this exact committed artifact and event in the
actual dev chat; record source SHA, event ID/state, content and next action in a
committed receipt. The content to verify is: S3 completed with documented history
limits; S4 first-direction delivery/receipt remains in progress; C4/C5 are not
complete; P901/P903 task execution stays deferred to S5 and P904 remains DRAFT.

Sender tests PENDING create/identical KEEP, changed summary/next-action rejection,
direct PENDING-to-ACK rejection and empty-SENT-evidence rejection, preserving raw
failures and unchanged event bytes/history/count. After actual tool success the
sender records SENT and ends its turn. Receiver's real committed receipt permits
the next finite S4 action: sender records ACK, checks post-ACK KEEP and repeated
ACK rejection. No receipt is inferred from send success or a queue read.

The existing actual human S1-S5 same-project two-role delivery grant covers this
test. No new human question, new chat, remote, product work or automatic monitoring
is needed. This event is specifically the S4 trial, unlike earlier coordination.
